metadata.description: Local marketplace for zeon-project-skill — single-plugin repo. Use `/plugin marketplace add <repo-path>` then `/plugin install zeon-project-skill@zeon-local` to test the skill locally.

plugins.name: zeon-project-skill
plugins.description: Author, extend, and refactor Zeon (everything-prototype-containers) projects — skills, workflows, worlds, objects, canvases — with byte-accurate templates and schema-aware validation. Works with or without the Zeon product installed locally.
